notes.title: 🚀 Car Service Simulator – Hotfix Released!
notes.content:
[h1]🔧 Hotfix v0.1.1 Update[/h1][p]🎯 A small but impactful patch is here! This update fixes many issues and improves UI and systems for a smoother experience. Here are the details:[/p][p][/p][h3]🏚️ Junkyard System[/h3][list][*][p]The junkyard system has been completely updated.  [/p][/*][*][p]Equipment now has a cost.  [/p][/*][*][p]Equipment selling has been added and made easier to use.  [/p][/*][*][p]The basket system has been removed from the game.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]🔊 Audio Updates[/h3][list][*][p]New footstep sounds have been added.  [/p][/*][*][p]Trash pickup/drop sounds are now included.  [/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle sounds have been improved.  [/p][/*][*][p]A sound effect for receiving money has been added.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]📋 Task & UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Task panels are now more descriptive (especially for junkyard tasks).  [/p][/*][*][p]Action steps in task texts are now highlighted with color and bold font.  [/p][/*][*][p]Foam and water animations now trigger correctly upon task completion.  [/p][/*][*][p]The sleep indicator will now remain visible until the player falls asleep.  [/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements have been made to the inventory system.  [/p][/*][*][p]Incorrect money display during payment has been fixed.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]🤖 Worker System[/h3][list][*][p]Worker equipment system has been fixed.  [/p][/*][*][p]Various bugs in worker AI have been resolved.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️ Repair Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]The auto-aim behavior of the tool during car wash/painting has been disabled.  [/p][/*][*][p]In engine repair, failed steps now repeat until done correctly.  [/p][/*][*][p]In hammer repair, the tool no longer drops instantly after a mistake – it drops after several failed attempts.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the moving line wouldn't stop when hit during hammer repair.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]🅿️ Parking System[/h3][list][*][p]Vehicles now exit the parking area smoothly without getting stuck.  [/p][/*][*][p]Cars now leave properly.  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Thanks to your feedback, the game is getting better with each update.  [/b][/p][p][b]Have fun!  
[/b][/p][p][b]— Red Axe Games Team 🚗💨[/b][/p][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/mQgnEnuH9G"]Join Our Discord Channel![/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/f35188cc267850d5b0d604f311802237c3d6940d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Car Service Simulator – Developer Diary #7 🔥
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/xNvGYSkTx8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/59de0d372e6748f7e5d4095fcd998b9601c1fc16.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello, Mechanics!👨‍🔧[/b][/h1]

First off  huge thanks to everyone who played the demo and added Car Service Simulator to their wishlist.

After a short breather, we’re back in the garage, tools in hand, continuing to build the experience you helped shape. The demo phase helped us spot what was missing, and now… it’s time to show you what’s new under the hood.

[h2][b]New Car: Yonda C2000 Joins the Lineup! 🚘[/b][/h2]

Meet Yonda, the latest ride to roll into your garage. Sleek, sturdy, and begging for a tune up, this new car adds more variety to your workday. With unique engine configurations and custom part layouts, Yonda will put your mechanical skills to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/fc2fabb5b90ee77bb9c2713e1767a1155efadf7c.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Worker System: You're Not Alone Anymore! 👷 [/b][/h2]

Ever wish you had a second pair of hands? Now you do!

We’re introducing the Worker System hire AI workers to help around the garage. Whether it’s handling simple diagnostics, cleaning up the shop, or prepping parts, your team will grow alongside your reputation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/ba73c18b1f0c5b98e269c8601ea09d3d084bfffc.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Mechanic:  Car Parts Can Now Be Dropped! 🔩 [/b][/h2]

Mistakes happen even to the best mechanics. And now, they matter.

In Car Service Simulator, if you fail during a repair or disassembly, the part you're working on can actually fall to the ground. This adds a whole new layer of realism and challenge. Dropped parts might get damaged, dirty, or even roll under the table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/27c6fd4d9a9bca9c7662015891580a8405469be9.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Your Garage. Your Legacy. Your Feedback. ✅[/b][/h1]

Now, it’s your turn. This isn’t just a game it’s a world built for you. Your experience, your keen eye for detail, your feedback they’ll shape this into the ultimate Car Service Simulator.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268930/Car_Service_Simulator_Demo/ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

[h1][b]See you in the dream garage! 🔧[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Only 3 Days Left Until the Demo! – Developer Diary #6 👨‍🔧
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/xNvGYSkTx8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/59de0d372e6748f7e5d4095fcd998b9601c1fc16.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hello, mechanics!👨‍🔧[/b][/h1]

Close your eyes for a moment. Imagine standing in a dimly lit garage, the scent of oil and metal hanging in the air. Your hands are wrapped around a rusted engine, lifeless silent. But with each bolt you tighten, each wire you reconnect, something stirs. And then… that moment. The engine roars back to life, the deep hum vibrating through your bones. It’s not just a machine it’s a heartbeat, revived by you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/e39f54ace3413629c344fc59df339fe908d1e13b.png[/img]

[h1][b] Only 3 Days Left: Car Service Simulator Demo! 🔧[/b][/h1]

Countless hours, sleepless nights, way too much coffee we’ve poured everything into Car Service Simulator, and now it’s almost time to hand you the keys. The Demo launches on February 24th, 2025, as part of Steam Next Fest, and we need real mechanics like you to put it to the test.

But before you get your hands dirty, we want to show you a few glimpses of the game. Just a little taste

[h2][b]Walkthrough Garage: A Sneak Peek Inside! 🚗[/b][/h2]

Let’s take a quick look inside the garage! From the workstations to the tools you’ll be using, this is where all the magic happens. Get familiar with your space before you roll up your sleeves and get to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/54fac2bf44883e9dc1c5d37d3b91f3101652bc42.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Garage Equipment: The Tools You'll Use! 🛠️ [/b][/h2]

Every great mechanic needs the right tools!🔧 

In Car Service Simulator, you’ll get hands-on with a variety of professional garage equipment. Get ready to repair, restore, and fine-tune every car that rolls into your shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/608f124b40c3eaf9b64bf2fd76edfb4ca1501125.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/a59741abd603e0ef8d7cc60dd4a00cc3de2b6b1b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Bed Area: Your Rest Spot in the Garage! 🛏️[/b][/h2]

Even the best mechanics need a break! In Car Service Simulator, the Bed Area is your personal space to recharge after long hours in the garage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/7e7a931cbab6f887f5ebc650c2537f5eab5125b7.gif[/img]

[h2][b] Customize Your Garage Sign: Make It Yours! 🏷️[/b][/h2]

Your garage, your rules! In Car Service Simulator, you can rename your garage and create a sign that truly represents your style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/01d66ac5721842232e7526cf29e1131b896da8f4.gif[/img]

As indie developers, we don’t have corporate backing or unlimited resources. What we do have is pure passion, stubborn determination, and the dream of building something authentic. Every wrench turned, every pixel placed, every line of code fueled by nothing but love for the craft (and, yeah, probably too many cups of coffee).

[h1][b]Your Garage. Your Legacy. Your Feedback. ✅[/b][/h1]

Now, it’s your turn. This isn’t just a game it’s a world built for you. Your experience, your keen eye for detail, your feedback they’ll shape this into the ultimate Car Service Simulator.

notes.content:

[h1]Hello Mechanics!👨‍🔧[/h1]

As the Car Service Simulator team, we are continuing to push forward with the development of our game.

We are excited to share with you our participation in the upcoming Steam Next Fest in February 2025.

In this devlog, we will talk about the latest updates in our development process and the challenges we have encountered.

[b]The current view of our garage is not the final version, and we will share a new view of our garage with you soon.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/6ff7e7183452a4607bf8da1a7e535978fba115cf.gif[/img]

"The game is under development, visuals may change."

[h1][b]For Your Garage: Local Markets 🏠[/b][/h1]

In the city, you can source parts for car repairs or your daily needs from these markets. But beware, if you head out without a shopping list, you might end up buying more than necessary and cluttering your garage!

[h3][b]Automarket[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/deb2bd7b643a646cce3983fcf6eca3c0e34ffd7d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Car Parts Market[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/edea7fec678fe168c8399372e9fbae624da83914.png[/img]

[h3][b]Auto Glass Market[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/222730de6b57d228b1cb41742612505b10895349.png[/img]

[h3][b]Junkyard[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/ee1a0a60a9dd8244fecb7f0a23f82aeb27773ac3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Tire Market[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/b70405120ef39378f04191d71d5f444859cede7d.png[/img]

[h1][b]Car Driving Mechanics 🚗[/b][/h1]

We have elevated the driving experience in our game to a new level.

Now, you will feel every movement of your vehicle more vividly, and taking corners will feel like you are a racer. But remember, being a good driver is as important as being a good mechanic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/ef675aef42bbda5770f5a5e5932d14d4c1452685.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/a1646b35d13b8890dd7b09e9c826a8b99c4490df.gif[/img]

"The game is under development, visuals may change."

[h1][b]Office Computer Panel 🖥️[/b][/h1]

We have added a new computer panel to your office. With this panel, you can easily manage your customer records, orders, and finances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/927e9cb40cb44fccc7d045a2d259d79dce599ea2.gif[/img]

"The game is under development, visuals may change."

[h1][b]Car Washing and Customer Car Parking 🅿️[/b][/h1]

We have made the car washing and parking process more efficient. Make sure to wash and park your customers' cars properly. Remember, the maintenance of a vehicle is not limited to its internal mechanics; its appearance must also be impeccable!

notes.title: Car Service Simulator - DevLog #1 🚗🧰
notes.content:
[b]Welcome! Car Service Simulator DevLog #1: Updates, Interactions, and More Await You... 🔥[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/mQgnEnuH9G][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/59de0d372e6748f7e5d4095fcd998b9601c1fc16.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Hello Mechanics! 👨‍🔧[/h1]

Can you smell the motor oil? Here's our DevLog with the latest updates from our game! 🚗💨

[b]We also have some exciting news! You’ll be able to play the demo version in near future.[/b]

[h1][b]Planned Features for the Demo[/b][/h1] 
[list]
[*]Localization (Language Support)
[*]Sound Variety
[*]Particle and Shader Improvements
[*]Animation Improvements
[*]Settings Menu
[*]Save & Load System
[*]Sleep System
[*]Garage Sign Customization
[*]Day-Night Cycle and Lighting Enhancements
[*]Final Version of the Garage Model[/list]
[h1][b]New Features ✨[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Customer Interaction[/b][/h2]

When customers arrive at your garage, you’ll wonder, “What do they want this time?” After explaining their vehicle’s problems, they’ll ask you for a price. Haggling? Of course! Who doesn’t love a discount? 💸

[h2][b]Gameplay Interactions 🎮[/b][/h2]

You’re not just repairing cars in your garage. You can chat with NPCs, grab items from the junkyard, and shop on the computer. And don’t forget to negotiate! Don’t let the vendors trick you! 😏

[h2][b]Equipment Usage 🔧[/b][/h2]

Got a broken part? Pick the right equipment and start getting your hands dirty! Talking about repair speed? You can grab better tools and finish the job in no time. As the saying goes: “Good equipment, less sweat!” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/7a39b31431d6630a4e1b3b3bae41fdee039f31b0.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Vehicle Interaction 🚗[/b][/h2]

Open the doors and the hood, inspect every part of the car. Once you’ve struck a deal, you can take the car for a test drive before and after the repair. But be careful, don’t speed and get too excited during the test drive! 🚦

[h2][b]Garage Interactions 🛠️[/b][/h2]

There’s nothing like playing around with the machines in the garage! Change the color of the paint gun, refill the water tanks, or lift the car with the hoist. There’s plenty to do in your garage, don’t miss the chance! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/38b5466a1958be544f105c10fb67a9f570bde796.gif[/img]

[h2][b]AI (Artificial Intelligence) Employees 🤖[/b][/h2]

Your employees are the backbone of your garage! Assign them tasks, watch them work, and even give them a little guidance. I can almost hear them saying, “Do I have to do everything?” You handle the management, they handle the work! 

[h2][b]Markets and Junkyard 🏪[/b][/h2]

When the sun rises, the markets open, and when night falls, they close. Grab your truck and go shopping! Discover the differences in quality between the shops. And don’t be surprised if you find a treasure in the junkyard! Who knows what valuable items lie among those worn-out parts? 🚚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/afe3de0ca6b44bdf4ba24df918529cd9844b4f35.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Car Repair Process 🔧[/b][/h2]

Fix deformed parts, meet painting requests, or replace parts. Do customers want modifications? Make them happy, so they can show off their car's new look! 🎨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177040/a9cec743b123c4baab5631e85d6baaaf011934d4.gif[/img]

[h2][b]XP Gaining and Leveling Up 🏆[/b][/h2]

Every repair gives you XP! As you level up, cooler equipment awaits you. Deliver the car on time, and you’ll get extra XP. If you’re late? Sorry, but your XP will decrease... 

[h2][b]Earning and Spending Money 💰[/b][/h2]

Earn as you repair, spend as you shop! Money is always circulating in the garage. By the end of the day, check your daily report. Did you end the day with a profit, or did you lose money on those repairs? You’ll find out! 💸

[h2][b]Traffic System 🚦[/b][/h2]

There’s a living traffic system in the game world. Some of these vehicles will stop by your garage for repairs. Who knows, there might even be a classic car among them! 🚗

[b]We’ll share more details with you in the next DevLog.[/b]
